description: The SIMT skill registry. Hand-authored and reviewable; structure is declared, never inferred (docs/plans/0002-simt-dev-cli.md section 3.1). Resolution is deterministic: same repo + same task = same answer.

conventions.variants: One node, several bodies, discriminated by stack. Used when the SAME skill name exists in several repos with genuinely different content (the 8 duplicated Social names).
conventions.variant-stack: A variant stack must name the tag that DIFFERS between the bodies, not a tag both repos share. cloudflare-workers is emitted by repo-06 as well as repo-07 (both ship a wrangler.jsonc), so an api variant listing it matches the web repo too and stops discriminating; hono is the tag that actually separates them. Lint can check that variant stacks are pairwise disjoint, but not that they are discriminative in practice - the goldens test resolves every variant-bearing skill against both real repos and requires exactly one match.
conventions.variant-of: Several nodes that are siblings, discriminated by stack. Used when siblings have DIFFERENT names (web-security-review / api-security-review). Both mechanisms resolve identically: one body per stack.
conventions.sources.role: canonical = the body that becomes the single home. variant = a real distinct body. stub = a thin pointer to another node. duplicate = byte-identical to the canonical body. deprecated = retired name, see alias-of.
conventions.deferred: Derived, not chosen: deferred is true exactly when totalBytes exceeds deferredThreshold. Hand-editing it is a lint error.
